Hello, my friend! It is Ananse again. Today we will put two groups together.
Three mangoes are sitting here. Two more are sitting over there.
Count this little group with me.
Now count the other little group.
Three and two. When we put them together, we say three plus two.
Push them together, and count the whole lot from one.
Now two mangoes here, and two mangoes over there.
Two plus two. Push them together.
Plus means we put the groups together.
Then we count them all, starting at one.
Your turn now. Count out a pile of mangoes for hungry Ananse.
